title: Synoptic Panel Library and Token Mapper for Console Variants
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a reusable 'Synoptic Panel' component library in Figma and a corresponding token-mapper spec that unifies visual tokens across cost views, rollout rails, and dashboard microcards. The goal is to reduce visual drift between Console surfaces (dashboards, rollout lists, budget forecast widgets) by providing a set of adaptable components that map to a small set of compound tokens (color, elevation, density, emphasis). This ticket covers: 1) an interactive Figma kit with variants for density and state, 2) a token mapping spreadsheet/spec for engineering (token name, semantic meaning, fallback rules), and 3) an annotated review with product and engineering to finalize naming and accessibility thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Figma Synoptic Panel library published with < 10 master components and clear variant axes for density/emphasis/state
Token mapping spec exported as a single-sheet CSV and a human-readable doc that details fallbacks and platform constraints
Hand-off package includes example JSON snippets for dev (color tokens, spacing tokens, focus states) and two coded reference pages in Storybook linked in the ticket
Design review completed with PM/Eng and all major comments resolved (or turned into follow-ups)
Accessibility checks: contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text tokens, keyboard focus visible states documented
decisions: Compound token approach: use semantic tokens (panel-bg, panel-elev-1, panel-border-muted) rather than raw color tokens to allow runtime swapping
Density axis will be 'compact | default | spacious' mapped to specific spacing scale values to remain deterministic for engineering
Rollout rail uses 'emphasis' variant mapping (default, highlighted, muted) instead of introducing new colors to reduce token surface area
Prototype interactions will be built using Figma interactive components (auto layout + variant swaps) rather than separate frames to ease maintenance

notes: Aim for the smallest viable token surface area to avoid exponential mapping complexity across Console surfaces. Keep naming semantic and stable; prefer 'panel-*' over ad-hoc color names. We'll treat this as the canonical source for panel-like surfaces and deprecate older one-off tokens in a follow-up migration ticket.
